method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); one regulative rule (the applicant's 12 months to file, s 58(2)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Succession Act 2006 No 80 (NSW), corpus document nsw_legislation:2023-07-14/act-2006-080 from the Open Australian Legal Corpus (collected 10 March 2025; unofficial, possibly out of date), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2006-080.txt (text sha256 9f828f5f42719e0eb03c06ff4c780253823ce0807165b0771b3d318b195c559d)

seat: the applicant, or would-be applicant, for a family provision order out of a dead person's estate (spouse, de facto partner, child, former spouse, dependant, or close personal companion of the person who died)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run sfp-dates.l4 ; l4 run sfp-claims.l4 ; l4 run sfp-cases.l4
checks.result: 172 assertions written, 172 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-08)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: Chapter 3 (family provision and notional estate): ss 3(1)-(4) as used, 55 (glosses), 57, 58, 59, 63, 64, 70(1) (comment), 70(2)-(3), 72(1), 73, 74-80 (with s 77(2)-(3) for an event other than the death), 81, 82, 83, 87 (comment), 88, 89(2)-(3), 90 (s 90(1)(a) from the filing day), 93, 94, 95, 96, 97 (gloss), 98(2), 99(1) with 78(2), and Sch 1 Pt 3 cl 11(1)-(2), with cl 11(4) as a comment. Out: s 56, Sch 1 Pt 3 cl 9, 10 (machinery); Sch 1 Pt 3 cl 11(3), (5), (6) (earlier Acts, outside the sources); s 70(4) (turns on revocation of the grant under the 1898 Act); s 60, 61, 62, 65-69, 71, 72(2), 84-86, 89(1), 91, 92, 98(3)-(5), 99(2)-(4), 100 (Court powers and procedure with no applicant-answerable test; s 99(2) maximum costs are in a regulation not deposited); Chapters 2 (wills) and 4 (intestacy), left for other encodings.
